primitives.name: Drive Status Transition Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Each book's Drive field in the master table below flips from `pending` to its Drive link as its upload verifies.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D(t)': 'Drive status at time t, binary {pending, linked}', 'T_{verify}': 'Verification timestamp'}
primitives.assumptions: Upload verification is deterministic and occurs after file staging.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D(t) = pending and t < T_{verify}, transition to D(t) = linked upon successful upload.

layer2.mapping: The Drive status flip mirrors a Bayesian update from prior belief to posterior certainty about data availability.
layer2.telemetry: Local path integrity check + Google Drive API response validation.

primitives.name: Engine Training Value Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: **How to use this file:** the master table below carries one row per verified item — title, authors, year, lane, original source URL, what it is, the engine-training value, local path, Drive status.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V_{train}': 'Training value associated with item, dimensionless score', 'I': 'Verified item identifier'}
primitives.assumptions: Each item has a unique V_{train} derived from its content type and labeling quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When I is unverified, V_{train} is undefined or zero.

layer2.mapping: V_{train} serves as kernel weight in GSE's similarity search over verified items.
layer2.telemetry: Automated scoring algorithm applied to item metadata and content structure.

primitives.name: Per-Lane Index Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: One row per verified item: `TITLE | AUTHORS | YEAR | LANE | SOURCE_URL | WHAT_IT_IS | TRAINING_VALUE | LOCAL_PATH | DRIVE` Per-lane INDEX.md files live in lane-a-situational/ · lane-b-medical/ · lane-c-systems/ · books-a-sports/ · books-b-medical/ · books-c-systems/ · books-d-models/ · social/.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_i': 'Lane identifier, categorical', 'I_j^{(L_i)}': 'Item j in lane i'}
primitives.assumptions: Items within lanes are semantically coherent and indexed independently.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cross-lane dependencies require explicit inter-index linking.

layer2.mapping: Each lane index defines a category-theoretic slice of the global manifest space.
layer2.telemetry: Index.md file consistency and item count validation per lane.

The Drive status flip acts as a stochastic event that updates beliefs about data availability, modeled as a Bernoulli process. The lane-based indexing enables conditional probability distributions over items, allowing GSE to reason about data relevance and GSI to perform conformal prediction on training values. Failure modes include misclassification of items due to incorrect metadata, or delayed Drive transitions causing temporal inconsistency in the belief system. Dualities emerge between the physical storage layer (local path) and logical abstraction layer (Drive link), with the transition representing a phase shift in data accessibility.
